description: PLAN §14 Infrastructure Capacity & Monitoring Thresholds for Brand Sewa Commerce Platform

cpu.actionOnScaleTrigger: Plan vertical VPS upgrade or offload compute

ram.actionOnScaleTrigger: Upgrade VPS RAM budget (move from 4GB to 8GB) or tune Postgres shared_buffers

dbConnections.actionOnScaleTrigger: Connection pool waits appearing. Tune container pool sizes or deploy connection pooler (PgBouncer)

uncachedP95.actionOnScaleTrigger: Uncached response p95 exceeds 500ms SLA. Investigate slow queries, missing indexes, or CPU saturation

jobLag.actionOnScaleTrigger: Background queue lag exceeds 2 minutes. Increase worker concurrency or scale worker service

singleStoreLoadShare.actionOnScaleTrigger: Noisy neighbour detected: single tenant consuming >25% of shared platform capacity. Throttle via rate limit, raise tier, or migrate to dedicated instance
